exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Two procedural limits: (1) LR 56.1(d)(5): a movant's statement of material facts may not exceed 80 numbered paragraphs without the court's permission, and v2 has 86, so either trim 6 or ask leave before 11/20. (2) LR 7.1: no brief over 15 pages without prior approval of the court, and the memorandum is at 17; if you seek leave, a brief over 15 pages also needs a table of contents with page numbers and a table of cases. Both need leave before the filing, so a motion for leave would need to go in early next week. Your and Andrew's call which to cut.
